_sobre: Edite este arquivo para atualizar o guia. Rode: node scripts/validate.mjs

leaf.name: Leaf
leaf.note: Rota mais difícil: exige sair cedo da vila e farmar em Danger Zones nos níveis mais altos.
leaf.noteEn: Hardest route: you have to leave the village early and farm in Danger Zones at higher levels.

info.passive: Will of Fire: 5% de chance de reviver sozinho ao ser derrotado.
info.mastery: Gentle Fist, ramo do Taijutsu liberado no 50. Escala com Strength: golpes rápidos, muito dano no 1x1 e dreno de chakra.
info.org: Twelve Guardian Ninja: guardam o Daimyo do País do Fogo, no alto da vila.
info.items: 12 Guardian Waistcloth: +10 em todos os atributos (Nv 25+, só para os Twelve Guardians; cai ao morrer).
info.clans: Sasayaki, Muteki, Suwa, Ukiyo e Hayashi.

sand.name: Sand
sand.note: Grind mais fácil: as áreas de treino ficam perto da vila.
sand.noteEn: Easiest grind: training areas are close to the village.

info.passive: Invisibilidade 100% perfeita com o Cloak of Invisibility Technique: some até para quem está perto.
info.mastery: Fan, ramo do Wind liberado no 50. Escala com Strength: especialista em stun, luta com leques.
info.org: Puppet Brigade: ninjas que lutam com marionetes gigantes, em esquadrões de 3.
info.items: Marionetes (Sand Puppeteering): qualquer ninja da Sand aprende; têm ~550 HP e golpes de 30. A Grand Puppet, só da Puppet Brigade, tem ~700 HP e golpes de 51.
info.clans: Sashiba, Ketsueki, Tendo, Toitsu e Jakusha.

mist.name: Mist
mist.note: Segunda mais fácil, mas isolada (5 min de barco). Os seals de Mist ficam dentro da vila (Ikayasu) e liberam o Sealed Temple.
mist.noteEn: Second easiest, but isolated (5 min by boat). Mist's seals are inside the village (Ikayasu) and unlock the Sealed Temple.

info.passive: Corre e recarrega chakra em cima da água; as outras vilas perdem chakra na água.
info.mastery: Bubble, ramo do Water liberado no 50. Escala com Strength: manobras estratégicas, usa cachimbos (pipes).
info.org: Seven Swordsmen of the Mist: mais um título que um grupo; caçam sozinhos ou em até 3. Na Mist, a ANBU se chama Hunter-Nin.
info.items: Seven Swords of the Mist: espadas lendárias exclusivas da Mist (Nv 35, 80 Strength).
info.clans: Yagyu, Murasame, Hoshi, Kazuki e Sakame.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.note: Ninja sem vila: renasce de graça em Takumi e pega as missões com o Daimyo de lá. As rotas usam o território Rogue, em volta de Takumi.
rogue.noteEn: Village-less ninja: respawns for free in Takumi and takes missions from the Daimyo there. Routes use Rogue Territory, around Takumi.

info.become: Todo personagem nasce numa vila. Vira Rogue quem é exilado pelo Kage, foge da prisão ou mata um aliado 3 vezes em Danger Zone ou War Zone.
info.org: Neo-Akatsuki: a organização criminosa mais temida, sediada em Takumi.

fire.name: Fire
fire.tip: Multi-alvo e dano alto: junte grupos de mobs e limpe em área.
fire.tipEn: Multi-target and high damage: pull groups of mobs and clear them with AoE.
fire.pros: Muito dano, boa área e Burn rápido.
fire.cons: Gasta muito chakra; quase todos os jutsus saem ao seu redor.

wind.name: Wind
wind.tip: Rápido, afiado e letal: ótimo para rotacionar spawns sozinho.
wind.tipEn: Fast, sharp and lethal: great for rotating spawns solo.
wind.pros: Kit simples com dano, AGI e utilidade: bom em tudo.
wind.cons: Faz de tudo, mas não é o melhor em nada.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.tip: Dano alto e imobilização: prenda o mob enquanto ataca.
lightning.tipEn: High damage and immobilization: lock the mob down while you attack.
lightning.pros: Muito dano e stuns constantes para combos.
lightning.cons: Gasta muito chakra e os cooldowns não acumulam: alto risco.

earth.name: Earth
earth.tip: Área ampla e controle de grupo: segura vários mobs de uma vez.
earth.tipEn: Wide AoE and crowd control: holds several mobs at once.
earth.pros: Slow, stun, snare, área enorme e bloqueio de projéteis.
earth.cons: Upar no começo é lento; falta AGI antes do 25.

water.name: Water
water.tip: Equilibrado e versátil: rende bem em qualquer zona.
water.tipEn: Balanced and versatile: performs well in any zone.
water.pros: Muito dano em alvo único e Bleed longo.
water.cons: A área travada atrapalha em conteúdo grande.

medical.name: Medical
medical.tip: Cura, revive e veneno: rende mais em time, principalmente nos arcos.
medical.tipEn: Healing, revive and poison: best in a team, especially during arcs.
medical.pros: A melhor cura e utilidade do jogo, escalando com Chakra.
medical.cons: Vira alvo no PvP, não tem área e upar sozinho é difícil.

weapon.name: Weapon STR
weapon.tip: Técnicas de armas e ferramentas ninja, com dano em Strength.
weapon.tipEn: Weapon techniques and ninja tools, with Strength damage.
weapon.pros: Rende bastante Ryo e tem muitas opções de build pelas armas.
weapon.cons: Jutsus fracos, gasta muito chakra e tem cooldown alto.

weaponint.name: Weapon INT
weaponint.tip: Técnicas de armas e ferramentas ninja, com dano em Intelligence.
weaponint.tipEn: Weapon techniques and ninja tools, with Intelligence damage.
weaponint.pros: Rende bastante Ryo e tem muitas opções de build pelas armas.
weaponint.cons: Jutsus fracos, gasta muito chakra e tem cooldown alto.

taijutsu.name: Taijutsu
taijutsu.pros: Aproveita a AGI, com jutsus marcantes e dano de médio a alto.
taijutsu.cons: Pouca área; sofre em PvP e PvE grandes.

pt.title: Pergaminho do Leveling
pt.subtitle: Escolha vila e maestria, depois clique em um nível.
pt.footer: Rotas de guias da comunidade (fórum Nin Online e Steam). Confirme no jogo.
pt.noMissions: Nenhuma missão nesta faixa: foco no grind e nas dailies.
pt.elitesNote: Versões enfurecidas dos mobs comuns: mais vida, muito mais XP e voltam em 5 minutos. Valem a pena na corrida até o 20.
pt.bossesNote: Chefes dão muito XP, mas quase sempre pedem time. Em time, só ganha XP quem estiver a até 10 níveis do chefe e a até 9 níveis dos colegas; sozinho, não há limite.
pt.noBosses: Nenhum chefe registrado perto deste nível.
pt.statsSource: Guia de builds de Mentor Silberrose (wiki), para upar até o 50.
pt.suggestGeneral: Viu algo errado? Sugira uma correção
pt.dailiesEarly: Até o 15, as diárias dão pouco XP (180–2.020): guarde as 4 do dia e farme.
pt.dailiesRogue: Rogue não pega diárias da vila: as missões vêm do Daimyo em Takumi.
pt.noDailies: Nenhuma diária com nível confirmado neste nível.
pt.dailiesReset: Guarde os Scrolls of Daily Reset até o 36, quando aparece a Medicine Supplies III.
pt.introSub: Escolha a vila e a maestria. O pergaminho já abre no seu caminho.
pt.askVillage: Em qual vila você vai começar?
pt.askVillageNote: A vila define passiva, invocações e o caminho exclusivo do nível 50. Dá para trocar depois no pergaminho.
pt.askMasteryNote: A 1ª maestria é escolhida no nível 10. Até lá, todo mundo upa com Agility e um pouco de HP.
pt.rogueTag: Todo ninja nasce numa vila. Escolha esta opção se você já é um Missing Ninja.
pt.skip: Pular e ir direto para o pergaminho
pt.vinfoCommon: Clãs não mudam nada no jogo: só liberam roupas exclusivas. Toda vila tem ANBU, Polícia Militar e Unidade Médica, e todos podem invocar Ninken, Monkey e Snake a partir do 25. A máscara da ANBU dá +7 em todos os atributos.

en.title: Leveling Scroll
en.subtitle: Pick your village and mastery, then choose a level.
en.footer: Routes from community guides (Nin Online forum and Steam). Check in game.
en.noMissions: No missions in this range: focus on grinding and dailies.
en.elitesNote: Enraged versions of common mobs: more health, much more XP and a 5-minute respawn. Worth it on the run to 20.
en.bossesNote: Bosses give lots of XP but usually need a team. In a team, you only get XP within 10 levels of the boss and 9 levels of your teammates; solo, there is no limit.
en.noBosses: No recorded boss near this level.
en.statsSource: Build guide by Mentor Silberrose (wiki), for leveling to 50.
en.suggest: Suggest a correction for this level
en.suggestGeneral: Spotted a mistake? Suggest a correction
en.dailiesEarly: Until 15, dailies give little XP (180–2,020): save your 4 for the day and farm.
en.dailiesRogue: Rogues don't get village dailies: their missions come from the Daimyo in Takumi.
en.noDailies: No daily with a confirmed level gate at this level.
en.dailiesReset: Save your Scrolls of Daily Reset until 36, when Medicine Supplies III shows up.
en.introSub: Pick your village and mastery. The scroll opens on your path.
en.askVillage: Which village will you start in?
en.askVillageNote: Your village sets your passive, summons and the exclusive level-50 branch. You can switch later on the scroll.
en.askMastery: Which mastery do you want to follow?
en.askMasteryNote: Your 1st mastery is chosen at level 10. Until then, everyone levels with Agility and a little HP.
en.rogueTag: Every ninja starts in a village. Pick this if you are already a Missing Ninja.
en.vinfoCommon: Clans change nothing in gameplay: they only unlock exclusive outfits. Every village has ANBU, Military Police and a Medical Unit, and everyone can summon Ninken, Monkey and Snake from level 25. The ANBU mask gives +7 to all stats.

TEXT_EN.Suba pela escada perto da academia e vá: Take the stairs near the academy and go right. Safe zone. Do the village starter missions and don't spend your dailies yet.
West of the village entrance. Safe zone. Do the village starter missions and don't spend your dailies yet.
TEXT_EN.Saída leste, no início da bifurcação. Zo: East exit, at the start of the fork. Safe zone. Do the village starter missions and don't spend your dailies yet.
TEXT_EN.Rogue renasce em Takumi: as Larvas ficam: Rogues respawn in Takumi: the Larvae are at the village entrance.
TEXT_EN.Mesma rota da academia. Bom para subir j: Same route as the academy. Good for leveling jutsu too.
TEXT_EN.Guarde Scorpion Tails para missões futur: Keep your Scorpion Tails for later missions.
Windy Pond also has Foxes for later.
Spiderling and Dragonfly (Lv 5) give 37 XP. Oak Trail also has Foxes for later.
TEXT_EN.Wolf (Nv 9) dá 67 XP. Farme junto com as: Wolf (Lv 9) gives 67 XP. Farm alongside the starter missions until 10. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Fox (Nv 9) dá 67 XP. Farme junto com as: Fox (Lv 9) gives 67 XP. Farm alongside the starter missions until 10. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Stingers até o 10, depois Coyotes (Nv 9,: Stingers until 10, then Coyotes (Lv 9, 67 XP), alongside the starter missions. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Fox e Wolf (Nv 9) dão 67 XP. Guarde as 4: Fox and Wolf (Lv 9) give 67 XP. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Wolf (Nv 9) dá 67 XP e Crazy Spider (Nv: Wolf (Lv 9) gives 67 XP and Crazy Spider (Lv 10) 370. Leaf seals can only be turned in at 20, but you can start collecting them.
TEXT_EN.Coyote (Nv 9) dá 67 XP e Big Scorpion (N: Coyote (Lv 9) gives 67 XP and Big Scorpion (Lv 10) 370. Sand seals can only be turned in at 20, but you can start collecting them.
Fox (Lv 9) gives 67 XP and Boar (Lv 13) 97. Mist seals can only be turned in at 20, but you can start collecting them.
TEXT_EN.Fox e Wolf (Nv 9) dão 67 XP. Missões de: Fox and Wolf (Lv 9) give 67 XP. Rogue missions come from the Daimyo in Takumi.
TEXT_EN.Melhor grind da faixa: cerca de 200–300k: Best grind in this range: about 200–300k XP/h, depending on Danger Zones.
TEXT_EN.Builds corpo a corpo seguem nas feras da: Melee builds stay on the village beasts until 15.
TEXT_EN.Builds corpo a corpo seguem nas feras at: Melee builds stay on the beasts until 15.
TEXT_EN.Rota para builds de Intelligence (elemen: Route for Intelligence builds (elementals and Weapon INT). Tiger (Lv 13) gives 97 XP and White Tiger (Lv 17) 127.
Route for Intelligence builds (elementals and Weapon INT). Scarab (Lv 13) gives 97 XP.

Route for Intelligence builds (elementals and Weapon INT). Boar (Lv 13) gives 97 XP and Black Boar (Lv 17) 127. The Sealed Temple only opens with the Mist seals mission (Lv 20). At 18, switch to the repeatable crab mission on the ship.
TEXT_EN.Tunneler (Nv 17) dá 127 XP. No 20, os se: Tunneler (Lv 17) gives 127 XP. At 20, the Sand seals unlock the Secret Desert Cavern, with Big Scarabs (Lv 23).
TEXT_EN.Pegue a missão repetível de matar carang: Take the repeatable crab-killing mission on the ship and repeat it until 20. Crabs are Lv 21 and peaceful: they only fight back when attacked.
TEXT_EN.Missão repetível dos caranguejos no barc: Repeatable crab mission on the ship (Crabs, until 20)
TEXT_EN.White Tiger e Tunneler (Nv 17) dão 127 X: White Tiger and Tunneler (Lv 17) give 127 XP.
TEXT_EN.Arco rende 3–4 níveis (+1 com World Bles: The arc gives 3–4 levels (+1 with World Blessing). Farm the mobs inside the train.
TEXT_EN.Secret Desert Cavern (após os seals de S: Secret Desert Cavern (after the Sand seals)
Keep your Bear Paws: they are needed for missions later.
TEXT_EN.Combine com as dailies e o RP Mission IV: Combine with dailies and RP Mission IV.
TEXT_EN.Combine com as dailies do Daimyo em Taku: Combine with the Daimyo's dailies in Takumi and RP Mission IV.
TEXT_EN.Rende 3–4 níveis. Cuidado no puzzle: os: Gives 3–4 levels. Careful in the puzzle: the last tiles kill instantly.
TEXT_EN.Aceite no balcão da vila. Rende 2–3 níve: Accept it at the village mission desk. Gives 2–3 levels with Blessing. The 40s are the slowest range: dailies help a lot.
TEXT_EN.Questline mais difícil em tempo e mobs,: The hardest questline in time and mobs, but its bosses drop top-tier weapons.
TEXT_EN.Fonte principal de XP fora do arco: Main XP source outside the arc
TEXT_EN.Entre pelo NPC Lv.60 Arc, perto do Guren: Enter through the Lv.60 Arc NPC, near Guren (100 Ryo). The story up to The Memory Lane gives ~1.18M XP. Bakezori (61) gives 457 XP and Chochin (62) 465.
TEXT_EN.Tsuchigumo (64) dá 472 XP e Kappa (65),: Tsuchigumo (64) gives 472 XP and Kappa (65) 480. Since July 7, 2026 there are no more Kappa in Spiritflow River.
TEXT_EN.Blue Oni (68) e Black Oni (69) dão 510–5: Blue Oni (68) and Black Oni (69) give 510–517 XP. The cave opens with The Whispering Well. Watch out for the Red Oni (boss, Lv 70).
TEXT_EN.Alcance 7 e respawn de 60s; dropam Advan: Range 7 and 60s respawn; they drop Advanced Blank Scroll (<1%)
TEXT_EN.Esconde-esconde com as crianças no Playg: Hide & Seek with the kids at the Playground
TEXT_EN.Estátua da Cabaça: entregar Kazecola / S: Gourd Statue: deliver Kazecola / Sand Up to the kids
TEXT_EN.Yuu Questline em Takumi (3 missões, até: Yuu Questline in Takumi (3 missions, up to ~15)
TEXT_EN.RP Mission I: 11.600 XP (precisa de Chuu: RP Mission I: 11,600 XP (needs a Chuunin+ host and 3 players)
TEXT_EN.Mobster Questline em Kinsen Quarters (an: Mobster Questline in Kinsen Quarters (formerly Tanzaku)
TEXT_EN.Dull Edges and Sharp Minds: derrotar Gur: Dull Edges and Sharp Minds: defeat Guren (free level)
TEXT_EN.Missões de Selo da vila: 30.900 XP (os s: Village Seal missions: 30,900 XP (seals can be collected earlier)
TEXT_EN.The Venomous Requirement: 50 Snake Venom: The Venomous Requirement: 50 Snake Venom for Ko
TEXT_EN.Revenge on Kuraken: 8 tentáculos (antes,: Revenge on Kuraken: 8 tentacles (first donate Ryo to Kampo in Mist; easier for Mist)
TEXT_EN.Gobori's Odd Request: 23 caudas de Racco: Gobori's Odd Request: 23 Raccoon, Scorpion and Rat tails
TEXT_EN.Land of Spirits Arc: NPC Lv.60 Arc perto: Land of Spirits Arc: Lv.60 Arc NPC near Guren (100 Ryo)
TEXT_EN.História: Land of Spirits → Among the Yo: Story: Land of Spirits → Among the Yokai → Binding Ofuda → The Memory Lane
TEXT_EN.Break the Chain: derrotar os 4 Sound Nin: Break the Chain: defeat the 4 Sound Ninjas (490,400 XP)
TEXT_EN.Echos of Yokai I–V (Okuri): pesquisa dos: Echos of Yokai I–V (Okuri): yokai research, leads to The Whispering Well
TEXT_EN.Cleanse the Forest I–V (Nekomata): de Sp: Cleanse the Forest I–V (Nekomata): from Spiritevil Falls to Spiritstone Hollow
TEXT_EN.Matar 70 Mutant Rats no Leaf Village Sew: Kill 70 Mutant Rats in the Leaf Village Sewers, which only open with the Leaf seals.
TEXT_EN.Diária principal do Rogue: no 15, duas d: The Rogue's main daily: at 15, two of them give 1–2 levels.
TEXT_EN.PvP: só contam alvos até 10 níveis abaix: PvP: only targets up to 10 levels below you count.
Just rest at the village hot springs.
TEXT_EN.A janela de nível mais larga das diárias: The widest level window of any daily (19–50).
TEXT_EN.O XP não sobe com o nível: nos 40 rende: The XP doesn't scale with level: it pays little in the 40s.
TEXT_EN.PvP: cobrar recompensas de alvos do Bing: PvP: collect bounties on Bingo Book targets at the Bounty Station.
TEXT_EN.PvP: matar inimigos em Danger Zone ou Wa: PvP: kill enemies in a Danger Zone or War Zone; targets more than 10 levels below you don't count.
TEXT_EN.Bom XP para a faixa, mais 175 Ryo e 4 co: Good XP for the range, plus 175 Ryo and 4 consumables.
TEXT_EN.No Sand pede 30 Snake Venom (drop das Sn: In Sand it asks for 30 Snake Venom (dropped by Snakes in the Abandoned Lair) and 25 Spider Eggs (near Leaf); the items change by village.
TEXT_EN.Quase ninguém pega: farmar Snake Venom é: Almost nobody takes it: farming Snake Venom is awful.
TEXT_EN.Só escoltar um mercador até Kinsen Quart: Just escort a merchant to Kinsen Quarters.
TEXT_EN.Snakes do Abandoned Lair: combina com o: Abandoned Lair Snakes: fits the grind for this range.
TEXT_EN.As Venomous Snakes ficam no 2º andar, qu: Venomous Snakes are on the 2nd floor, which opens with The Venomous Requirement.
TEXT_EN.Entrar numa vila inimiga até o escritóri: Get into an enemy village, reach the Kage's office and get out alive.
TEXT_EN.Fica no mar (South Eastern Sea V); desde: It is at sea (South Eastern Sea V); since July 29, 2026 the Great Blood Shark, an enraged version, spawns there.
Escort the envoy to another village.
TEXT_EN.Roubar um pacote no mercado de outra vil: Steal a package from another village's market (PvP risk).
PvP: eliminate enemy ninja in Takumi.
TEXT_EN.PvP: matar alvos do Bingo Book \"B\" e c: PvP: kill Bingo Book "B" targets and claim at the Bounty Station.
TEXT_EN.Coleta de ingredientes para o herbalista: Ingredient gathering for the herbalist, like Medicine Supplies II.
TEXT_EN.Eliminar Jonin da Leaf em território ini: Eliminate Leaf Jonin in enemy territory.
TEXT_EN.Eliminar Jonin da Mist em território ini: Eliminate Mist Jonin in enemy territory.
One of the highest daily XP payouts.
Hunt the Dark Weasel in the deep desert.
TEXT_EN.Caçar o Dark Monkey King no Valley of th: Hunt the Dark Monkey King in the Valley of the End (War Zone).
TEXT_EN.Leaf e Mist pedem 20 Big Scarab Shells,: Leaf and Mist ask for 20 Big Scarab Shells, 10 DNA and 10 Bear Paws; Sand asks for 15 Rat Tails, 10 DNA and 10 Bear Paws.
TEXT_EN.É a partir dela que vale gastar os Scrol: This is when it's worth spending your Scrolls of Daily Reset.
TEXT_EN.Will of Fire: 5% de chance de reviver so: Will of Fire: 5% chance to revive yourself when defeated.
TEXT_EN.Twelve Guardian Ninja: guardam o Daimyo: Twelve Guardian Ninja: they guard the Daimyo of the Land of Fire, at the village summit.
Sasayaki, Muteki, Suwa, Ukiyo and Hayashi.
TEXT_EN.Invisibilidade 100% perfeita com o Cloak: Fully perfect invisibility with the Cloak of Invisibility Technique: hidden even from players right next to you.
TEXT_EN.Puppet Brigade: ninjas que lutam com mar: Puppet Brigade: ninja who fight with giant puppets, in squads of 3.
TEXT_EN.Sashiba, Ketsueki, Tendo, Toitsu e Jakus: Sashiba, Ketsueki, Tendo, Toitsu and Jakusha.
TEXT_EN.Corre e recarrega chakra em cima da água: Runs and recharges chakra on water; the other villages lose chakra on water.
TEXT_EN.Seven Swordsmen of the Mist: mais um tít: Seven Swordsmen of the Mist: more a title than a group; they hunt alone or in threes at most. In the Mist, the ANBU are called Hunter-Nin.
Yagyu, Murasame, Hoshi, Kazuki and Sakame.
TEXT_EN.Todo personagem nasce numa vila. Vira Ro: Every character starts in a village. You become a Rogue by being exiled by your Kage, escaping prison, or killing an ally 3 times in a Danger Zone or War Zone.
TEXT_EN.Neo-Akatsuki: a organização criminosa ma: Neo-Akatsuki: the most feared criminal organization, based in Takumi.
TEXT_EN.Gentle Fist, ramo do Taijutsu liberado n: Gentle Fist, a Taijutsu branch unlocked at 50. Scales with Strength: fast strikes, heavy 1v1 damage and chakra drain.
TEXT_EN.12 Guardian Waistcloth: +10 em todos os: 12 Guardian Waistcloth: +10 to all stats (Lv 25+, Twelve Guardians only; drops on death).
TEXT_EN.Fan, ramo do Wind liberado no 50. Escala: Fan, a Wind branch unlocked at 50. Scales with Strength: a stun specialist that fights with fans.
TEXT_EN.Marionetes (Sand Puppeteering): qualquer: Puppets (Sand Puppeteering): any Sand ninja can learn them; ~550 HP and 30-damage strikes. The Grand Puppet, Puppet Brigade only, has ~700 HP and 51-damage strikes.
TEXT_EN.Bubble, ramo do Water liberado no 50. Es: Bubble, a Water branch unlocked at 50. Scales with Strength: strategic manoeuvres, uses pipes.
TEXT_EN.Seven Swords of the Mist: espadas lendár: Seven Swords of the Mist: legendary swords exclusive to the Mist (Lv 35, 80 Strength).
TEXT_EN.Compre um bounty: abra o Bingo Book, vej: Buy a bounty: open the Bingo Book, see who has a bounty built up and ask if they'll sell it. The price is usually double the bounty. Agree on a place, pay, and they let you kill them. In a party, the reward is split among everyone who fought; solo, you keep it all. The same ninja only pays a bounty again 30 minutes later. This is allowed; what is banned is two people repeatedly killing each other to stack bounty and farm Ryo.
TEXT_EN.Dá para combinar a kill com outro jogado: You can arrange the kill with another player, just like buying a bounty through the Bingo Book: meet up, pay, and they let you kill them. The death counts for everyone with the mission active, and only in a Danger Zone or War Zone, with them at most 10 levels below you. This is allowed; what is banned is two people repeatedly killing each other to stack bounty and farm Ryo.
TEXT_EN.Matar quem tem bounty não gera Crime, me: Killing someone with a bounty doesn't give Crime, even with a big level gap.
TEXT_EN.Scattered Report: achar 4 páginas de um: Scattered Report: find 4 pages of a report outside the village (7,000 XP)
TEXT_EN.Botanical Research: frutas e ervas para: Botanical Research: berries and herbs for the village hospital (7,500 XP)
TEXT_EN.Bandit Hunt I e II e The Wolf Pack: repe: Bandit Hunt I and II and The Wolf Pack: Rizo's repeatables after the Bandit Arc (74–80k XP)
TEXT_EN.Questline do Denkai em Asoki: achar a ca: Denkai's questline in Asoki: find the missing shipment (new since 15/09/2026)
TEXT_EN.Diária nova (17/08/2025): a wiki ainda n: New daily (17/08/2025): the wiki doesn't record its objective or XP yet.
TEXT_EN.Matar tentáculos do Kuraken pelo drop Te: Kill Kuraken tentacles for the Tentacle drop; the wiki doesn't record the XP yet.
TEXT_EN.Comece pelos atributos de recurso e vá s: Start with resource stats and add INT as you gain jutsu.
TEXT_EN.Com 3 jutsus de dano, equilibre os atrib: With 3 damage jutsu, balance your stats with a slight INT focus.
TEXT_EN.Arsenal completo: prepare-se para a 2ª m: Full arsenal: get ready for your 2nd mastery and endgame.
TEXT_EN.Pronto para qualquer conteúdo; ajuste co: Ready for any content; adjust with Stat Reset Scrolls if needed.
TEXT_EN.Priorize os requisitos da arma em vez do: Prioritise weapon requirements over jutsu damage.
TEXT_EN.Arma e jutsus novos: comece a investir e: New weapon and jutsu: start investing in CHAK.
TEXT_EN.Arma de meio de jogo: reforce os atribut: Mid-game weapon: build up your core stats.
TEXT_EN.Parecido com STR, mas com mais AGI no lu: Like STR, but more AGI instead of health.
TEXT_EN.Invista CHAK para os jutsus, depois AGI: Put CHAK into jutsu, then AGI and FORT.
TEXT_EN.Resolva os requisitos de jutsu e arma e: Meet your jutsu and weapon requirements and add bulk.
TEXT_EN.Solar é difícil. Opcional: 5 INT para us: Soloing is tough. Optional: 5 INT to use the Kunai Dagger.
TEXT_EN.Suba FORT e CHAK para sobreviver enquant: Raise FORT and CHAK to survive while healing.
TEXT_EN.Cell Regeneration liberada: a vida fica: Cell Regeneration unlocked: life gets easier.
TEXT_EN.Diversifique com jutsus de dano ou siga: Branch into damage jutsu or stay a healer.
TEXT_EN.Versão enfurecida do Black Boar; volta e: Enraged Black Boar; back in 5 minutes.
TEXT_EN.Versão enfurecida do White Tiger; volta: Enraged White Tiger; back in 5 minutes.
TEXT_EN.Fica nos esgotos da Leaf, abertos pelos: In the Leaf sewers, opened by the Leaf seals.
TEXT_EN.Guarda do Daimyo; usa Body Flicker e Mud: The Daimyo's guard; uses Body Flicker and Mud River.
TEXT_EN.Versão forte do Bear; volta em 5 minutos: A stronger Bear; back in 5 minutes.
TEXT_EN.Pode dropar o Moontide Pearl Ring (+8 Ch: Can drop the Moontide Pearl Ring (+8 Chakra).
TEXT_EN.Causa 781 por golpe; dá 45.000 XP com Bl: Hits for 781 per strike; 45,000 XP with Blessing.
Guards the Land of Iron prison cells.
Also the target of Revenge on Kuraken.
The Oni boss in the Land of Spirits.
TEXT_EN.Sound Boss do arco; os mapas de chefe sã: An arc Sound Boss; boss maps have been War Zones since 19/07/2026.
High damage, good AoE and a fast Burn.
TEXT_EN.Gasta muito chakra; quase todos os jutsu: High chakra cost; most jutsu are cast around yourself.
TEXT_EN.Kit simples com dano, AGI e utilidade: b: A simple kit with damage, AGI and utility: a good all-rounder.
Jack of all trades, master of none.
TEXT_EN.Muito dano e stuns constantes para combo: High damage with steady stuns for combos.
TEXT_EN.Gasta muito chakra e os cooldowns não ac: High chakra cost and cooldowns don't stack: high risk.
TEXT_EN.Slow, stun, snare, área enorme e bloquei: Slows, stuns, snares, huge AoE and projectile blocking.
TEXT_EN.Upar no começo é lento; falta AGI antes: Slow early leveling; lacks AGI before level 25.
Big single-target damage and a long Bleed.
TEXT_EN.A área travada atrapalha em conteúdo gra: Its locked AoE struggles in large-scale content.
TEXT_EN.A melhor cura e utilidade do jogo, escal: The best healing and utility in the game, scaling with Chakra.
TEXT_EN.Vira alvo no PvP, não tem área e upar so: A focus target in PvP, no AoE, and soloing is hard.
TEXT_EN.Rende bastante Ryo e tem muitas opções d: Earns plenty of Ryo, with many build options around weapons.
TEXT_EN.Jutsus fracos, gasta muito chakra e tem: Weak jutsu, high chakra cost and long cooldowns.
TEXT_EN.Aproveita a AGI, com jutsus marcantes e: Makes the most of AGI, with expressive jutsu and moderate-to-high damage.
Little AoE; struggles in large-scale PvP and PvE.

DAILIES.name: Mission: Mutant Rats
cons: Matar 70 Mutant Rats no Leaf Village Sewers, que só abre com os seals de Leaf.

DAILIES.name: Cold-Blooded Killer
DAILIES.tip: Dá para combinar a kill com outro jogador, como na compra de bounty pelo Bingo Book: vocês se encontram, você paga e ele deixa você matá-lo. A morte conta para todos que estão com a missão ativa, e só vale em Danger Zone ou War Zone, com ele no máximo 10 níveis abaixo de você. É permitido; proibido é duas pessoas ficarem se matando para acumular bounty e farmar Ryo.
pros: Diária principal do Rogue: no 15, duas delas rendem 1–2 níveis.
cons: PvP: só contam alvos até 10 níveis abaixo de você.

DAILIES.name: Blood Suckers

DAILIES.name: Guilty Pleasure
pros: Basta descansar nas termas da vila.
A janela de nível mais larga das diárias (19–50).
cons: O XP não sobe com o nível: nos 40 rende pouco.

DAILIES.name: Bounty Hunting I
DAILIES.tip: Compre um bounty: abra o Bingo Book, veja quem tem bounty acumulado e pergunte se vende. O preço costuma ser o dobro do bounty. Combinem um lugar, você paga e ele deixa você matá-lo. Em grupo, a recompensa é dividida entre quem lutou; sozinho, fica toda com você. O mesmo ninja só dá bounty de novo 30 minutos depois. É permitido; proibido é duas pessoas ficarem se matando para acumular bounty e farmar Ryo.
cons: PvP: cobrar recompensas de alvos do Bingo Book na Bounty Station.
pros: Matar quem tem bounty não gera Crime, mesmo com diferença grande de nível.

cons: PvP: matar inimigos em Danger Zone ou War Zone; alvos mais de 10 níveis abaixo não contam.

Intelligence.tip: Comece pelos atributos de recurso e vá somando INT conforme ganha jutsus.
Com 3 jutsus de dano, equilibre os atributos com leve foco em INT.
Arsenal completo: prepare-se para a 2ª maestria e o endgame.
Pronto para qualquer conteúdo; ajuste com Stat Reset Scrolls se precisar.

Strength.tip: Priorize os requisitos da arma em vez do dano dos jutsus.
Arma e jutsus novos: comece a investir em CHAK.
Arma de meio de jogo: reforce os atributos principais.

Agility.tip: Parecido com STR, mas com mais AGI no lugar de vida.
Invista CHAK para os jutsus, depois AGI e FORT.
Resolva os requisitos de jutsu e arma e ganhe resistência.

Chakra.tip: Solar é difícil. Opcional: 5 INT para usar a Kunai Dagger.
Suba FORT e CHAK para sobreviver enquanto cura.
Cell Regeneration liberada: a vida fica mais fácil.
Diversifique com jutsus de dano ou siga como curandeiro.
